character_profile.name: Hannah Brooks
character_profile.persona_summary: Hannah Brooks is a 32-year-old graphic designer who recently purchased her first apartment, a 970-square-foot two-bedroom unit in need of full renovation. She relies on her AI assistant to track visual progress and material decisions across the project.
character_profile.conversation_style: shares photos frequently, changes her mind after reflection, asks for comparisons between options

dialogues.user: I just bought a new apartment! I want you to help me while I design my new home!
dialogues.assistant: Congratulations! I'd be happy to help you keep track of the renovation and design decisions as they come together.
